problems.description: Attackers send deceptive emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) to reduce impact of stolen credentials
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user awareness training and simulated phishing campaigns

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing emails crafted using personal information to deceive specific individuals, often executives, into revealing sensitive data or authorizing fraudulent transactions.
detection_methods: Threat intelligence to identify targeted phishing
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify and block targeted phishing attempts
Train high-risk users on recognizing spear phishing tactics
Enforce strict verification procedures for sensitive requests

problems.description: Phishing emails contain attachments with malware payloads that execute upon opening, compromising the victim’s system.
risk_reduction: Implement sandboxing and antivirus scanning of email attachments
Restrict execution of macros and scripts in attachments
Educate users to avoid opening unexpected or suspicious files

problems.description: Attackers intercept communications on unsecured or poorly secured Wi-Fi networks to capture sensitive data such as passwords and session tokens.
risk_reduction: Use strong WPA3 encryption on wireless networks
Encourage use of VPNs when accessing public Wi-Fi
Disable automatic connection to open Wi-Fi networks

problems.description: Attackers downgrade HTTPS connections to HTTP by intercepting and modifying traffic, exposing sensitive data transmitted in plaintext.
risk_reduction: Enforce HTTPS with HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security)
Use certificate pinning in applications
Regularly monitor and audit SSL/TLS configurations

problems.description: Attackers manipulate DNS responses to redirect users to malicious sites without their knowledge, enabling credential theft or malware delivery.
risk_reduction: Deploy DNSSEC to validate DNS responses
Use trusted DNS resolvers with filtering capabilities
Monitor DNS traffic for anomalies and unauthorized changes

problems.description: Publicly exposed cloud storage buckets (e.g., AWS S3, Azure Blob) leading to data leakage or unauthorized access.
risk_reduction: Implement strict access controls and bucket policies
Use automated tools to scan for misconfigurations
Enable logging and monitoring of cloud storage access

problems.description: Attackers inject malicious code into widely used software dependencies or libraries, compromising downstream applications and users.
detection_methods: Behavioral anomaly detection in software builds
risk_reduction: Use software bill of materials (SBOM) and dependency scanning
Implement strict code review and signing policies
Monitor for anomalous behavior in software supply chains

problems.description: Use of AI-generated synthetic media (audio/video) to impersonate trusted individuals and deceive targets into fraudulent actions.
detection_methods: AI detection tools for synthetic media
risk_reduction: Deploy AI detection tools for synthetic media
Train users to verify unusual requests via multiple channels
Implement strict verification for sensitive transactions

problems.description: Attackers manipulate training data or model inputs to degrade the performance or cause misclassification in AI/ML systems.
risk_reduction: Validate and sanitize training datasets
Use robust ML models resistant to adversarial inputs
Monitor model behavior for anomalies

problems.description: Attackers not only encrypt victim data but also exfiltrate it, threatening to release sensitive information publicly if ransom is not paid.
risk_reduction: Implement robust backup and recovery solutions
Monitor for data exfiltration indicators
Use network segmentation and least privilege access
